headline: I’m a Product Manager who turns messy, high-stakes journeys into simple, confident experiences.
paragraphs: In my previous venture, I was responsible for the lifecycle and launch of an automotive discovery and purchase platform - that reimagined how people explore and buy vehicles online, by fixing a fragmented process that was confusing for users and losing insights for brands. It is used by 1M+ buyers across Middle East & India, yields conversions at 2-3× industry benchmarks and trusted by brands like General Motors, Nissan, Royal Enfield, and VinFast.
I love bringing structure to messy information and finding patterns that drive clarity and action.
